resources.string: Compatibility fixes for supported older games
Enable this module in Vector (Xposed API 102), select the two supported games, then close and reopen each game. No device restart is needed.
Changes apply the next time the game process starts.
This engine version is not supported
Supports D4DJ D4U 1.2.1 and the installed セカイ 1.0.0 (com.sega.pjsekai.re), arm64. Fixes an old Unity memory-tracking crash. Does not provide game content or restore online services.
Enabled by default for the supported Sekai trial. Miss judgements and scores remain unchanged. Requires compatibility fixes to be enabled.
